name: Bubble-Fit
summary:
Bubble-Fit is a virtual reality experience designed to help older adults perform physical maintenance exercises in a relaxing beach environment. With three maintenance exercises, you can work on neck mobility, stretch your back, and exercise your hands and arms, all from the safety of your seat.
